import axiosInstance from"core/services/api/axiosInstance";const base_url=process.env.REACT_APP_API_URL;const API_URL=`${base_url}positions`;// Get user position
const getPosition=async access_token=>{const config={headers:{Authorization:`Bearer ${access_token}`}};const response=await axiosInstance.get(API_URL,config);return response.data;};// Delete user position

const createPosition=async(positionData,token)=>{const config={headers:{Authorization:`Bearer ${token}`}};const response=await axiosInstance.post(API_URL,positionData,config);return response.data;};const batchDeletePosition=async(positionIds,token)=>{const config={headers:{Authorization:`Bearer ${token}`}};const response=await axiosInstance.post(API_URL+"/batch-delete",positionIds,config);return response.data;};const positionService={createPosition,getPosition,deletePosition,updatePosition,batchDeletePosition};export default positionService;
